data.entity_name: Florida Age Verification for Material Harmful to Minors
data.content:
Florida Age Verification for Material Harmful to Minors
This regulation mandates age verification procedures to prevent access by individuals under 18 years to certain materials, necessitating both anonymous and standard verification methods.

Jellybean
Jellybean is an internal parental control system featuring notifications regarding minor access attempts to restricted materials.

Behavioral Anomaly Detection
Behavioral anomaly detection refers to the method used within the parental notification system to monitor and act upon unusual access attempts by minors.

Section 501.1737
Section 501.1737 of the Florida Statutes addresses the age verification requirements for protecting minors from harmful materials.

data.entity_name: Florida Social Media Use for Minors - Platform Characteristics
data.content:
Florida Social Media Use for Minors - Platform Characteristics
This regulation outlines requirements for social media platforms regarding algorithms that analyze user data for content selection and notification practices.

Section 501.1738
Section 501.1738 is referenced in the context of compliance requirements for age verification related to material harmful to minors.

Section 501.1736
Section 501.1736 of the Florida Statutes focuses on restrictions related to algorithmic content selection and push notifications for minors.

Geo-Flags
Geo-Flags are indicators used in the system to trigger alerts based on compliance with geographical laws and regulations.

ShadowMode
ShadowMode represents a feature that allows the parental notification system to gather analytics without impacting user experience.

Florida, US
Florida is the state where specific regulations regarding age verification and parental notifications are applicable for material deemed harmful to minors.

Compliance Detection System (CDS)
CDS is a mechanism in the system designed to log compliance-related activities and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.

Baseline Behavior (BB)
Baseline Behavior serves as a standard for user behavior against which anomalous activities are measured in the parental notification system.

Internal Monitoring Trigger (IMT)
IMT is a model used in the system for detecting anomalous behavior in user access, contrasting with standard user behavior to identify potential issues.

Glow
Glow is a compliance-flagging status used internally to signal geo-based alerts within the parental notification system.
